name: zrndr_draw_immediate_line
description: zRndr_DrawImmediateLine dispatches one unclipped 16-bit line to the active immediate rasterizer with the current frame buffer.
known_limits: tier S verification remains deferred to the zRndr draw-path source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x498bd0 validates passing zRndr::g_frameBuffer plus x0/y0/x1/y1/color16 to gRndr_pfnImmediateRaster4 and returning with fastcall stack cleanup.
Native smoke zrndr_immediate_line_dispatch_smoke installs a test immediate rasterizer and verifies the frame-buffer pointer, scalar coordinates, color, and dispatch count.
